text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I step into my office and notice something strange in the air.

text_block_list.name: Eerie Voice
text_block_list.text: I'm so lonely… Don't… leave me…

text_block_list.name: Eerie Voice
text_block_list.text: Are you… a friend?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In addition to the mysterious voice, I feel something cold and hard touch my neck. Gradually, it begins to press down harder, and…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …ner! Hey, Trainer! Can y'hear me?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You scared the daylights outta me fall'n to the floor like that! Are you feel'n sick?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wondering what just happened, I look around and notice a doll I've never seen before perched on my desk.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait a sec, that's Cafe's doll! She was show'n it t'me when I was hang'n out in her and Tachyon's li'l room…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Although, I feel like it had shorter hair back then…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Let's go tell Cafe you found it. She prob'ly dropped it somewhere near here, and someone decided t'put it on your desk.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Thank you. It looks like she ran off all by herself again…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I knew she must've been yours! I'm glad we could reunite you two!
choice_data_list: Wh-why are you acting like this is normal?!
Wh-why are you acting like this is normal?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I guess I'm just used to it? Where I'm from, mishaps like this are happen'n all the time.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: B'sides, these little cuties aren't so diff'rent from me! We can both move 'round and grow our hair!

text_block_list.name: Eerie Voice
text_block_list.text: I'm so lonely… So alone…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wowzers, she can talk too! But why's she feel'n lonely even after you two've been reunited?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: She's been longing for someone since I met her. I'm sorry for the trouble she's caused you both… I'll take her home now…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As soon as Manhattan Cafe says she'll take the doll away, my nerves start to relax.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wait a sec, Cafe!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Is there anyth'n we can do t'help?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: It doesn't feel right t'part ways like this, with her look'n bluer than Lake Gosho 'n' all.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Are you sure you can carry this burden?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Sure as day follows night! Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm not really on board with this at all, but they're looking at me so expectantly…
choice_data_list: I think it's better to help her move on.
Y-yeah! I'm sure we can all live in peace!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Y-y'mean to the a-afterlife?! It's not like we can force her! If we do that, we gotta make sure it's her choice t'move on.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Hm… There are some who agree to move on once they have no more unfinished business…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: In that case, I've just gotta look after her till she doesn't feel lonely! I've got enough good vibes for the both of us!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: There, there, sweetie. Ev'rything's gonna be just fine.

text_block_list.name: Eerie Voice
text_block_list.text: So… warm…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Okay, you two. C'mere and give her a nice pat on the head.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: There's a good girl…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After spending a few hours comforting the doll, that strange voice eventually disappears.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah! B'sides, we might get through t'her if we talk.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'll go first!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: What's the story, Dolly? What's got you so lonely?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I know it must be hard, but you'll only scare people away if y'start talk'n outta nowhere and mak'n things float in the air.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: If you stay on your best behavior, I'm sure you'll be able t'make some friends.

text_block_list.name: Eerie Voice
text_block_list.text: …Really?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You betcha! I mean, gosh, I'd play with you oodles and oodles! You're such a sweetie-pie!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin smiles gently at the doll, and as if the doll has accepted her words, the strange voice suddenly goes quiet.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: There's something… different about you, Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Even in the face of inexplicable events or people others might dismiss as scary, you always remain so calm and kind…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: You aren't even afraid to… share a room with me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: What're you say'n?! I love being your roomie. I could live with you forever!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: If you've got any more dolls or whatever giv'n you trouble, feel free to bring 'em by here an'time.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: B'sides, you're the kind one, Cafe. When I first got to Tracen, I was so scared and lonely… but then you made me a nice, hot cup of coffee. Help'n out's the least I can do!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Thank you… I'll have to brew you another cup… when we get back.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thank you kindly!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing the strong bond between Yukino Bijin and Manhattan Cafe in action warms my heart as well.
